common_candidate_binding: Root integration binding remains pending; 332 and other integrated components are excluded from this review.
scope: LargeCopy ABI v1 ordinary Copy Array/Tuple/Record >=4096 bytes, direct/ordinary function pointer calls and returns, default External versioning, CGU/cache, cleanup, and explicit unsupported special consumers.

identity.authority: Read current main-tree AGENTS.md, _zil_goal.md, task333 and frozen design 19.4, including 5eb792faf dependency clarification. Parent suite results were not counted as reviewer evidence.
identity.final_delta: 907 contains final production. 717 adds only cfg(test) models, fixtures/tests and documentation; fc935 adds only documentation of unresolved general large Enum/ErrorUnion scope.

static_checks.copy_in: Large parameters receive pointers to already prepared ValueId snapshots. Every actual callee parameter local is allocated independently and memcpy copy-in happens before source blocks. No source address authority is derived from these machine pointers.
static_checks.outptr_cleanup: Large result is first hidden ptr; return copies the retained ValueId snapshot after normal LIR cleanup then returns void. Caller output has a separate entry alloca. No aggregate SSA bridge is used for unhandled snapshot consumers.
static_checks.def_call_pointer: Physical definition/direct/ref/ordinary indirect/return paths share the same mapping and Unit erasure. Version dependency separately follows nested ordinary function pointer signatures and carriers without changing a small physical signature. Ordinary small Direct calls also select the versioned actual symbol.
static_checks.layout: copy_aggregates::layout derives checked x64 integer/pointer/array/struct allocation sizes and alignment from actual llvm_type, including Unit empty struct, bool byte allocation, padding and tail rounding.
static_checks.cgu_cache: machine_cgu resolves .lc1 definitions for grouping/imports and closed internalization. object_cache::machine_key hashes complete machine items and target namespace, including actual versioned symbols/signatures. Stable-symbol optimization can decline unsupported shapes instead of rebinding a .lc1 function through an old name.
static_checks.prepayment: One copy-planning remainder flows through snapshots, function/indirect mappings and recursive ABI dependency scanning; it is not refreshed per function/carrier. Shape and mapping costs precede allocation/event growth. Exact residual model controls and real Codegen N/N-1/fresh plus warm-cache denial were independently rerun. Default limits are unchanged.
static_checks.unsupported: Before function emission, actual closure captures and resource payloads are scanned with the same remainder. Affected closure entries/environments, resource helper interfaces and ForeignCallback dependencies are Unsupported, avoiding stale dedicated CallClosure/drop/scoped helper symbols. Ordinary borrowed Big and unaffected small function pointer captures remain supported.

limitations: The ordinary LargeCopy ABI and transitive pointer-carrier isolation receive PassLimited after R333-1 closure; no claim of complete large-value or language support is made.

The preserved 4096-byte move capture is CLI Verify1 Success and Codegen Unsupported with no LLVM/executable. Its explicit 2MiB API thread still aborts within Verify; 8MiB passing test setup is not a repair.

General >=4096-byte Enum/ErrorUnion bodies retain an uncompleted/unaccepted old inline ABI. There is no uniform size-based Codegen Unsupported gate; an incidental snapshot rejection is not a complete guard. No new crash probe for those forms was run.
Affected closure/helper/foreign combinations remain Unsupported where all consumers are not mapped. Borrowed Big and unaffected small function pointer closure/resource neighbors passed.
No workspace full suite, Windows native execution, or Rust runtime/RSS/performance comparison was run.

resolved_findings.problem: Version selection depends only on direct physical large parameter/result Slots. A physically small factory/apply/record wrapper can exchange an ordinary function pointer whose calling convention changed, retaining its old symbol and connecting an old consumer to a new incompatible pointee ABI.

resolved_findings.required_resolution: Independently represent transitive signature ABI dependency for symbol versioning while retaining the physical small argument/result mapping. Walk callable signatures and containing types; unchanged &Big alone must not acquire a large physical ABI. Close unimplemented special-entry consumers before artifacts.
resolved_findings.resolution: A separate Signature.versioned flag carries recursively changed ordinary-function-pointer ABI dependencies. Physical large() mapping is unchanged. Definitions, all ordinary Direct calls and FunctionRef use abi_symbol; affected closure interfaces/environments and resource helpers stop before artifacts.
